acceptanceCriteria: Retain reached negative witness for repeating an exact git add of a previously staged deletion, and a positive exact-scope two-phase staging witness.
Apply the narrow once-only deletion staging rule to the affected terminal controller without broad git add or changing product source, acceptance or immutable archive preservation.
Independent repair review verifies exact cached path/deletion set and unchanged source/controller bindings before actual execution.
body: Confirmed preparation harness friction, not product failure. #494 terminal actions.py docs() explicitly git-adds all25 paths in apply and again in finalize, including two archives already deleted and staged. Second invocation has no matching index/worktree path and fails. Independent preparation review SHA8ab82e11b763eefdf121fdd5f6ac8a214730eef835e01c5b5085f38fad1ad8fb identifies same class as earlier #496 harness. Dedup agent-memory staged/pathspec searches found no matching bug (V1-0540 is unrelated attestation). Exact AST-extracted private Git fixture reached the old second-add error and proved repaired repeated staging: stage two deletions once, stage only23 surviving paths in both docs phases, assert all25 cached paths plus exact2deletions/no unstaged differences. Evidence /private/tmp/c494-fair-admission-prep/implementation/terminal-execution-prep/STAGING-REPAIR.json and retained staging-before packet. CurrentCore163 Tasks202 macOS Git tool bytes frozen; original review172files/new179packet preserved. No product terminal run or costly3000measurement consumed. Independent incremental repair review pending when filed; broader workflow prevention remains open.
title: Private integration controllers repeat exact git add for already-staged archive deletions
